description: Use this tool for filtered HDB resale transactions, latest-period results, price ranges, medians, quartiles and price-per-square-metre statistics. It applies exact town and flat-type filters at data.gov.sg and performs the bounded aggregation inside the MCP; a direct API download is not required.

latestMonths.description: Number of latest available matching months to include when startMonth and endMonth are omitted.

transactionLimit.description: Maximum selected transaction rows to return alongside the statistics.

name: hdb_resale_stats
title: Query and summarise HDB resale transactions
